wire_format: Behavior vectors. Produce authentic encrypted archives with the actual versioned exporter or published fixtures before claiming restore coverage.
legacy_v4_text:
I wrote, “Try again—then listen.”
Keep this line exactly.

versions.given: One old stored picture or link and the original recorder.
expected: One ordered asset with original recorder
Known family visibility preserved
Old rendition marked only where supported by provenance

versions.given: A journal with family and diary entries before maps.
expected: Moment and asset IDs retained
Map and photo-inbox collections initialized empty

versions.given: A map with creative edges, saved steps and no reliable root.
expected: One deterministic project root
Existing nodes ordered by creation time then ID
Old creative edges preserved
New handoff contracts empty

versions.given: A dated local paragraph and earlier evidence under a writing section.
expected: Original node, authorship, and legacy text preserved verbatim
Docs pointer empty
No outbound lookup

versions.given: Month-only award, extra project link, writing pointer, frozen PDF and a portfolio item.
expected: Date precision, references and asset digests unchanged
Trash/recovery collections initialized empty

versions.given: A trashed project, recovered branch, prior consent and later withdrawal.
expected: Trashed state preserved
Later revocation wins or access stays inactive if recency unknown
Stable endpoints, checks and original authors survive

versions.given: P2 informs two builds, an unexpected failure is selected, one archived trial was revived and one source was corrected.
expected: Stable IDs, observed revisions and original outcomes survive
Both build links and revival links resolve in the same project
Selections and latest sharing revocations survive
Earlier archives initialize empty trial collections without inferred evidence
